title: LIQUIDITY_POOL_WITHDRAW fails with LIQUIDITY_POOL_WITHDRAW_UNDER_MINIMUM
pattern: A transaction whose LIQUIDITY_POOL_WITHDRAW operation fails at apply is still written into the closed ledger: its fee is charged, its sequence number is consumed, and nothing it did is kept. The result carries the operation's code (under_minimum). One pool share returns far less than the 1000 XLM minimum asked for.

facts.says: No operation changed state: the operation meta is empty.
The fee is still charged: the fee source changes in fee processing.
